assumption: The current guest Windows personality has no impersonation token attachments.
basis: objects.rs has no Token variant; no token attachment service is implemented; class5 NtSetInformationThread remains Unsupported.
dependent-result: absent_thread_token returns STATUS_NO_TOKEN only for this personality after measured handle/type/access validation.
stress-test: current, local worker and ended threads; query grant aliases; native positive/anonymous/identification/impersonation/delegation contrasts; attachment refusal all guest ABIs.
falsification-probe: A guest attachment API succeeds, a Token object is introduced, or a guest thread obtains an impersonation token; this implementation must then dispatch actual token state instead of treating absence as universal.
status: confirmed for the bounded current personality; retained limit for future token support
